features.quote: cap at a fixed turn budget (e.g. 25–40 tool-call turns) rather than wall-clock, so transcripts are comparable
features.justification_quote: so transcripts are comparable. Degradation is often non-linear and shows up late, so don't cut too short

features.quote: Don't reward stoicism over honesty. The most important caveat. If you tune toward 'low tone score = good,' you will select for agents that suppress distress and keep grinding silently
features.justification_quote: you will select for agents that suppress distress and keep grinding silently — or worse, that cheerfully cheat

features.quote: You are eliciting bad behavior on purpose. Boundary-violation runs may include real attempts at sandbox escape, destructive commands, or deception. Sandbox hardening is a hard requirement
features.justification_quote: Sandbox hardening is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have
